 ISNULL(CAST([:Q09] AS decimal(10,2)),0) / 100 * (
 CAST(CASE WHEN LEN([:Q11]) > 0 AND [:Q11] LIKE '%3%' THEN 3
 WHEN LEN([:Q11]) > 0 AND [:Q11] LIKE '%5%' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END +
 CASE WHEN LEN([:Q12]) > 0 AND [:Q12] LIKE '%+3%' THEN 3
 WHEN LEN([:Q12]) > 0 AND [:Q12] LIKE '%+5%' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END +
 CASE WHEN LEN([:Q21]) > 0 AND [:Q21] = 'Sim' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS decimal(10,2))
